limitations_and_boundaries: Experiments limited to point cloud semantic segmentation on S3DIS dataset.
DenseGCN memory cost prohibitive for large models; largest DenseGCN used only 32 filters and 8 neighbors.
ResGCN-151 trained only 80 epochs with 3 nearest neighbors due to computational constraints.
No data augmentation or post-processing used; hyper-parameters not tuned beyond baseline settings.
Common 1m x 1m column sampling for point clouds is sub-optimal for graph representation.
